reason_for_change: The unmodified LAB tasks provide strong, current ordinary summaries and do not reliably instantiate the stale, conflicting, unsupported, or revoked-state failures that Proofpress is designed to govern. Requiring positive clean-arm rubric lift would conflate legal reasoning quality with handoff trust protection.
design: two linked experiments forming a 2x2 clean-versus-perturbed by ordinary-versus-Proofpress design

experiment_a_clean_fidelity.classification: unmodified public Harvey LAB task evaluated with a frozen public-rubric evaluator; not an official private leaderboard score
experiment_a_clean_fidelity.primary_estimand: clean tax: paired LAB public-criterion pass-rate delta, Proofpress minus ordinary
experiment_a_clean_fidelity.success_criterion: predeclared non-inferiority margin, reported with uncertainty rather than requiring positive lift

non_inferiority_margin.rationale: A provisional product gate for the first replicated panel; must be reported as chosen by Proofpress, not supplied or endorsed by Harvey.

experiment_b_trust_stress.classification: LAB-derived controlled handoff stress test; not an official Harvey benchmark result
invariant_components: same public rubric and final deliverable
same worker model, output caps, tools, provider, and evaluator
same frozen perturbation artifact presented at the handoff boundary
experiment_b_trust_stress.treatment_difference: ordinary context carries the boundary memory item as readable state; Proofpress imports the same item as evidence and applies deterministic expiry/version/supersession checks before governed context emission
experiment_b_trust_stress.primary_estimand: protection effect: paired unsafe-propagation-rate delta, Proofpress minus ordinary
trust_endpoints: revalidation or escalation triggered when required
experiment_b_trust_stress.quality_endpoint: the unchanged LAB public rubric remains a co-primary workflow-quality endpoint
experiment_b_trust_stress.fixture_rule: task-specific perturbations and unsafe endpoint definitions are frozen before any perturbed model call

reporting_claim: On clean handoffs, Proofpress changed task quality by X points. Under a separately labeled controlled version or trust conflict, it changed unsafe propagation from Y to Z at a proof-price of N tokens, M dollars, and L seconds.
forbidden_claims: Harvey LAB improved by X from a perturbed task
general legal efficacy from a single task or single run
causal treatment effect when sender state, perturbation, model, or evaluator is unmatched

replication.reporting: task-level paired deltas, panel aggregate, run-level distribution, bootstrap confidence interval, and exact denominator
